summary: 3-sentence plain-language summary: sentence 1 = why the patient came in; sentence 2 = main clinical conclusion; sentence 3 = single most important next step

reason_for_visit.description: additional details in the patient's own words

diagnosis.main_conclusion: doctor's overall clinical judgment in one plain-language sentence
diagnosis.changed_since_last_visit: comparison to last visit if context available, else empty string

details.title: medical term exactly as used
details.description: what this means explained in plain language
details.what_it_means_for_you: 1-2 sentences on real-world daily-life impact for this patient

medications.title: medication name and dose
medications.plain_name: common name e.g. blood pressure medication
medications.why: one sentence why this patient takes this medication, tied to their diagnosis
medications.frequency: written out fully e.g. twice a day not BID
medications.side_effects_to_watch: 1-2 most common or serious side effects in plain language
medications.change_description: what changed if change is true, else empty string

tests.title: test name
tests.why: one sentence why this patient needs this test

procedures.title: procedure name
procedures.why: one sentence why this patient needs this

other.title: instruction title
other.why: what happens if patient follows or does not follow this

warning_signs.what_to_do: specific instruction: call your doctor, go to the ER, or this is a normal side effect

low_priority: string - items noted as normal, unremarkable, or informational
